record.body:
## Problem

Dashboard `d` clears Needs-you gates in one keypress without showing evidence, confirming, recording a rationale, or guarding the displayed revision.

## Approach

decide at discuss — evidence before action, confirm with note, revision guard (GitHub #8).

## Exit criteria

- decide at plan-phase — detail-then-confirm dismiss, approve/reject for plan review, revision guard, and superseded read-only constraints hold as verified.
